sentences.en: This kind of plant grows only in the tropical regions.
sentences.zh: 这种植物只生长在热带地区。

sentences.en: A unique fossil of a tropical plant was found recently.
sentences.zh: 最近发现了一种独特的热带植物化石。

sentences.en: The sun and a damp climate made the tropical rainforest.
sentences.zh: 阳光和潮湿的气候造就了热带雨林。

senses.zh: 热带的，tropical的；炎热的，酷热的

mnemonic: 词根记忆：trop（转）+ical（…的）→热得人晕头转向→热带的；炎热的
